name: BRDFitGapOrchestrator
description: Starts at BRDGen, FitMap or TestCraft, whichever the user chooses, and runs forward from there. Each agent keeps its own inputs, reviews and offers, and the next agent runs only on an explicit yes.

triggers.name: start_workflow
triggers.description: Start only on an explicit user request.

triggers.name: brd_file
triggers.description: A BRD or Fit-Gap document you already have. FitMap analyses it; TestCraft generates tests from it.
